case_title: State of Maharashtra vs Ramesh Kumar
judgment_text: The appellant challenged the conviction under Section 302 IPC. Upon reviewing the circumstantial evidence and forensic reports, the court found reasonable doubt regarding the identity of the accused. The conviction is set aside and the appeal is allowed.

case_title: ABC Infrastructure Ltd vs Union of India
judgment_text: This civil appeal pertains to an arbitration award under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996. The court held that judicial interference with arbitral awards is restricted to grounds of patent illegality or public policy violation. The petition is dismissed.
